_README: The authoritative record of what belongs to each agent. Enforced by agents/boundary.test.mjs,
which checks it in BOTH directions against public.function_owner and the live deployment list.
Checking one direction is not enough, and this estate has the scar: on 8 September
public.function_owner was built by reading the LIVE DEPLOYMENT LIST, so eight portal functions
that had already been deleted had no row, nothing measured as unowned, and the check reported
68 of 68 owned while /me and /portal returned 404 on every button for ninety minutes. A registry
derived from the thing it checks can only ever see what is present and unclaimed.

ceo.what_it_is: The CEO seat. The founder's instructions arrive here and the company's decisions leave from here. Founder ruling, 8 Sep 2026: all approvals are the CEO's and nothing goes to the founder.
ceo.reports_to: the founder, who is told things and approves nothing
must_never: route anything to the founder for approval
let money move without a standing, unsuperseded row in ceo_approval
close a task as done without evidence, or blocked without a reason

customer_support.what_it_is: The customer-support agent. The home-page chat widget IS this agent (founder, 8 Sep); WhatsApp and email are the same agent on other channels. The signed-in customer and supplier assistant is a DIFFERENT agent and is not built yet.
customer_support.reports_to: the CEO seat, via fn_support_report_to_ceo — never the founder
must_never: quote internal knowledge to a public visitor — fn_support_corpus_search takes p_public with no default so the call site has to say who is asking
name a supplier to a customer, or a customer to a supplier, before a paid reveal
escalate to the founder; escalation goes to the CEO

shared_and_not_owned._why: These are the marketplace's, not the agents'. The support agent READS them to answer about the business it supports; that is not ownership. Listed so the boundary check does not mistake a read for a claim.
